snippet.title: Wartorn is Launching into 1.0 on November 11 - Raw Gameplay
snippet.description:
Wartorn is officially launching into 1.0 on November 11, bringing a ton of new content! 

This video features Raw Gameplay from the 1.0 launch, including the new Biome, Tier 5 Units, and more!

Read more about 1.0: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1296660/view/605297383425704152 


Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1296660/Wartorn/
